hooray-sun-family-matching-sweatshirts.print_sentence: Adult sweatshirts spell HOORAY in chunky brown, gray and orange letters, and the kids' sweatshirts carry a matching rust-orange half sun with rays, on a soft cotton crewneck in cream or white.
hooray-sun-family-matching-sweatshirts.feature_text: Grown-ups wear the word and kids wear the little sun, so the whole family reads as one happy set in photos.
